appDescription.message: Spend too long on social media? A cat hijacks your screen. The cutest forced-break app.

customDomainsHint.message: One per line, or separated by commas. URLs are OK.

targetSitesHelpTitle.message: On sites with frequent page changes or reloads, tracking may reset more easily. We recommend using this on social media, video sites, or other services where you stay on the same site for a while.
